name: Seirei no Kuni no Chijo Hime-tachi ~Elfkko to Nekomimikko to Akumakko, Soshite Boku no Hatsujou Harem Days~
original_name: 精霊の国の痴女姫たち ～エルフっ娘と猫耳っ娘と悪魔っ娘、そしてボクの発情ハーレムデイズ～
source:
This world is made up of three spirits and one living spirit circulating spiritual power. The spirits that govern the time of morning, noon, and night share equally the spiritual power released by humans, the living spirits, thus an eternal equilibrium is maintained.

The spirits, bored with the balance of the world, began to plan how to outwit the other spirits. The main character, Kenbishi Naito, has no idea what is going on in the world of spirits. He actually has the highest spiritual power of any human being in existence, and one day, princesses are sent to him from each of the spirit worlds.

The princesses were all vying for him, saying "Please give me your spiritual power."

[Translated from [url=https://msrush.com/catalog/product/062_chi/SKCH.htm]official site[/url]]
translation:
这个世界由三位精灵与一个活灵共同组成，灵力在四者之间循环。掌管早晨、正午和夜晚的精灵，平均分享由人类这种活灵释放的灵力，从而维持永恒的平衡。

精灵们厌倦了世界的均衡，开始谋划如何智胜其他精灵。主人公剑菱内斗对精灵世界发生的一切毫不知情。实际上，他拥有所有现存人类中最强的灵力。一天，各个精灵世界分别派来一位公主。

公主们都争相向他请求："请把你的灵力给我。"

[翻译自[url=https://msrush.com/catalog/product/062_chi/SKCH.htm]官方网站[/url]]
